problem: A company-page post reused a personal/printer story family and production-vs-chat OAuth state diverged, causing incorrect company content and repeated manual recovery.
root_cause: Company topic identity, cross-channel story retirement, production OAuth authority and user-deleted replacement semantics were spread across separate rules instead of one inherited executable contract.
fix: Introduce one LinkedIn company standard-delivery policy inherited by chats/agents/schedulers: business-only topic gate, global printer retirement, production-runtime auth authority, safe self-heal, and one new-story replacement after explicit user deletion.
prevention: Reject personal-life topics before company content generation.
Treat printer as retired across both LinkedIn identities.
Read production Powerhouse/Composio state before any OAuth diagnosis.
Live token health outranks ACTIVE metadata.
Resume the same obligation after auth repair.
Allow at most one same-day replacement after explicit user deletion and require a new story fingerprint.
